description: Get detailed performance metrics for specific TikTok videos by ID. Returns views, likes, comments, shares, duration, and more. Max 20 video IDs per request.

account.description: Account name to query. Use list_accounts to see available options. Defaults to the first configured account.

video_ids.description: Array of TikTok video IDs to query (max 20)

name: get_video_details
